_readme: Which model each pga-* task runs on, when installed as subagents (python install.py --agent <name>).
light = text only, scripted steps (help, prompt, style, feedback); standard = writes prompts and judges images;
strong = frame-by-frame animation judgement (pga-anim). An empty value means: use the agent's current model.
Put your own cheaper/stronger model names here (they differ per account and change often), then re-run the installer.
Examples - codex model: a mini/spark codex model; gemini: a flash model for light, a pro model for standard;
opencode: provider/model (e.g. anthropic/claude-haiku-...); copilot: the model's display name.

descriptions.pga-help: List the pixellab-game-art slash commands with one example each, and how to start.
descriptions.pga-init: Set up PixelLab for a project: asks the user's PixelLab plan tier, then their art style (pick parameters or send a reference image), shows the resulting setup, and saves it as a named art style in pixellab.json.
descriptions.pga-style: Manage named art styles saved in pixellab.json: list them, switch the active one, show, rename, delete, or create a new one with the same setup conversation as /pga-init.
descriptions.pga-prompt: Improve any PixelLab prompt with the pixellab-game-art house style and show the better prompt, tool, size and cost - without generating anything. Detects the asset type.
descriptions.pga-char: Make a pixel-art character sprite (hero, monster, boss, NPC, portrait) with PixelLab in the pixellab-game-art house style - improves the description first, then generates, QA-checks and logs.
descriptions.pga-bg: Make a side-view pixel-art battle background with PixelLab in the pixellab-game-art house style - improves the scene description first (open ground, landmarks, palette, no characters), then generates, QA-checks and logs.
descriptions.pga-scene: Make a hub/menu backdrop, story/cutscene picture or region map in pixel art with PixelLab in the pixellab-game-art house style - improves the description first, then generates, QA-checks and logs.
descriptions.pga-building: Make a pixel-art building or prop (and upgrade tiers) with PixelLab in the pixellab-game-art house style - improves the description first (single building, side elevation, night light, no people), then generates, QA-checks and logs.
descriptions.pga-icon: Make pixel-art item, skill, status or relic icons (and rare/epic variants) with PixelLab in the pixellab-game-art house style - improves the description first, generates at 64 px for a clean downscale, QA-checks and logs.
descriptions.pga-anim: Animate a sprite's attack, skill or signature move in the pixellab-game-art house style - padded canvas, two painted key poses (wind-up, hit), a 10-frame animate_image between them, automatic flash checks, frame picking and an engine-ready sheet.
descriptions.pga-vfx: Turn a short effect idea into a painted, outlined pixel-art VFX clip with PixelLab's free vfx_workbench in the pixellab-game-art house style (strike / wave / eruption templates, lit puffs, hold-fast-hold timing), exported with per-frame durations.
descriptions.pga-batch: Make many pixel-art assets in one go with PixelLab (icons, monsters, props, backgrounds…): improves every prompt, shows one cost table, submits all jobs together, downloads, QA-checks and logs them, and returns one review sheet.
descriptions.pga-history: Show past generations from the job log - newest first, with cost, verdict and files - and what was spent (per command, tool and day). Free.
descriptions.pga-reroll: Re-run a past generation - the last one, or one named by file, name or words - with a new seed or the user's wording change, same tool and settings otherwise.
descriptions.pga-start: A guided first project for someone new to PixelLab: explains what happens at each step, suggests three starter assets that fit the saved art style, makes them one by one with a cheap draft first, and ends with what was spent and what to try next.
descriptions.pga-doctor: Check that everything the pixellab-game-art skill needs works - PixelLab connection and token, plan tier and balance, Python and packages, the project profile, the output folder, sharing - and print the exact fix for anything that doesn't. Free.
descriptions.pga-feedback: The user's choice about sharing generation outcomes (opt-in) with the skill's authors: see the status, switch it on (stats / prompts) or off, preview exactly what would be sent, send now, or delete everything this install sent.
descriptions.pga-analyze: Analyse a user's own pixel art (PNG, GIF or a folder) - pixel scale, density, palette, colour count, outline, shading tones, dithering, light, and for GIFs frame count, timing, holds and motion - then turn it into style rules saved in pixellab.json so every /pga-* command replicates that style.
descriptions.pga-tech: Explain the technical reason behind anything the pixellab-game-art skill or its commands do - a tool choice, a parameter, a script, a pipeline step, a cost, or a failure that just happened. Brief and direct.
descriptions.pga-update: Get the latest version of the pixellab-game-art skill (updated weekly with the lessons from shared results) and merge it into this install, keeping files the user changed; check for one, or undo the last update.
